notes.title: Celebrate Halloween with Enter Digiton - Heart of Corruption.
notes.content:
Heart of Corruption
This Halloween Enter Digiton has received a FREE DLC update. Every player that has purchased Enter Digiton will receive this DLC for free. This DLC will also remain free, forever.

Happy Halloween!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37566130/621c5820e1f29a99a5126efa13c179e4a1882928.png

About Heart of Corruption

 Included in the DLC is:
 Three new Corrupted bosses - Fight and destroy three new hideous bosses.
 Shield of Corruption - Your shield will now be able to kill most enemies.
 Remove your mask at any time.
 Widescreen support.
 Performance fixes.
 Bug fixes galore!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37566130/d964aa5c63cc7e52c9be352a108b157a7b284626.png

How to get Heart of Corruption
Heart of Corruption will be added to the base game for all players. Simply update your game to version 2.0 on 11 September 2020 or later. The main menu will have a new icon showing that the Heart of Corruption DLC has been installed.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37566130/91ad66848da4aeb3b575d6a606700debb35c7e9c.png

Thank You
Thank you for playing Enter Digiton and a special thanks to anyone that provided feedback.

notes.title: Enter Digiton Has Launched!
notes.content:
Thank you!
The date is finally upon us! It seems like just yesterday that the release was "months off", and now it's finally here. I hope you enjoy my game. I worked hard on it and I'm so proud of it. Thank you for your support.

Enter Digiton Version 1.0
The release of Enter Digiton is marked by the release of version 1.0. Many changes and revisions took place since 0.9. One of the larger features is a new portal room for easier fast travel. You can expect plenty of bug fixing updates after this one. I am not done with Enter Digiton.

The Future
Looking forward, I hope to provide two free DLC's for Enter Digiton. These are all currently a work in progress and development has not even begun yet. The roadmap looks as follows:

Version 2.0: Heart of Corruption - Fight three new unique bosses.
Version 3.0: Pandemonium - Leave your shield behind for a devastating sword.


Final Words
Once again, thank you for your support. Have fun in Digiton and enjoy your weekend!

notes.title: Enter Digiton - Preparing for Release
notes.content:
Release Candidate 0.9
The first Release Candidate build for Enter Digiton (Version 0.9 RC) is now available for testing. The new build brings: 

 A style overhaul
 New tutorials
 New PC controls
 More Cutscenes
 Bug fixes (details below)


Thank you to every beta tester currently helping out. Your hard work is appreciated. Plenty of bugs were squashed in your name.

The Future
Enter Digiton is currently scheduled to release on 14 August 2020. That's just two weeks from now. In the upcoming weeks a new trailer for Enter Digiton will also be released to reflect the new style. I am looking forward to releasing this game.

Changelog and Bugs

 Fixed a bug where jump height sometimes doubled.
 Fixed a bug where the player collider sometimes became larger than the player.
 Fixed a bug where the game would stutter in certain areas.
 Fixed a bug where finishing the game would break your save.
 Added a death tracker to the end credits scene.
 Added a credits scene.
 Added a new intro cinematic.
 Added a new ending cinematic with voice acting.
 Added a new color scheme to certain areas.
 Added a new tutorial banner for PC/XBOX controls.
 New and improved PC controls.
 Added Primordial Soul trackers to each area.

notes.title: Enter Digiton beta testing and release date!
notes.content:
Tomorrow, from the time of writing this, Enter Digiton will enter beta testing. The release of version 0.7 will also coincide with the launch of beta testing as well as the release date announcement. Enter Digiton is set to release on Aug 14, 2020 @ 9:00am PDT. I can't wait. ːsteamhappyː

I would just like to thank all the beta testers for helping me out. You guys are awesome!

Beta testing will stretch from 10 July 2020 to 21 July 2020.

Version 0.7 patch notes:

 Bug fixes.
 New zone story: Sanguine Castle.
 Refinement to the mask system.
 More achievements!
 Added some easter eggs too.

notes.title: Update 0.6 Released!
notes.content:
Version 0.6 of Enter Digiton is now available for testing.

Updated Changes:

 New movement system for more fluid movement.
 Added 6 new achievements.
 Added a new zone: The Sanguine Castle.
 Added new boss: Akaman.
 The carnival came to town. Find Sawbones on the Digiton Caves.
 Plenty of bug fixes.


Thanks for playing!
